policy: No third-party binary file (PDF/PNG/JPG/HWP) was downloaded or stored for any entry in this registry. Every entry's disposition is RECREATE_ONLY: provenance (URL, publisher, described field structure) is recorded here, and any dataset sample referencing it is a from-scratch recreation using fictional data (see evaluation/datasets/recreated/). This is the safe default per evaluation/datasets/real/README.md and the P1.5+ research task's own instruction to default to RECREATE_ONLY when redistribution terms are unclear -- which they are for every source below (government portals do not publish an explicit reuse license for form images; commercial form-vendor sites are paywalled/ToS-restricted).
